actual: Production MiniQMT sync-snapshot fails on rerun after BUG-247 cleanup because apply_cash_entry_once validates the hypothetical account update before detecting an existing cash_id conflict. A duplicate buy fill can make cash/frozen balances negative before ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING runs, causing HTTP 500 and blocking unattended MiniQMT reconciliation. Reproduce: POST /api/v1/qmt/virtual-strategies/sync-snapshot for account 62266303 trade_date 2026-06-04 after successful initial sync.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
